summary: Verified fix for 'Selected experiences laden niet'. /api/img proxy works: all 4 card images (w=800), heroes (w=1600), and the inline body image (w=1200) return 200 image/webp, resized, small (<600KB), and cached (2nd request fast). Disallowed src and invalid w return 400, missing src 422. Home #work: 4 cards render with --bg -> /api/img&w=800, all decode at 800px, no ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ORB / console errors. All 4 detail pages: hero loads 1600px, body image on 3f45... is rewritten to /api/img and loads, OVB video readyState=4, 'More work' shows 3 cards with proxied images. Regression: nav, card->detail->back, sections, footer, mobile layout OK. /api/experiences, /api/experiences/{id}, /api/sitemap.xml 200.

minor.issue: Review request says CMS JSON fetch retries on 5xx, but fetch_news has NO retry loop - a single upstream 5xx still gives 502 -> experiences-error state on the site.

Prefix check is a plain startswith; src like '<prefix>../other/x.jpg' passes (returned 404 from upstream instead of 400) because httpx normalizes dot-segments -> fetch escapes the koodh-clara path on the same host. Parse URL and reject '..' / normalize before checking.

PIL decode/resize/WebP encode runs synchronously inside async handler (blocks event loop for multi-MB images); wrap in asyncio.to_thread. Non-image upstream content (UnidentifiedImageError) -> unhandled 500. Concurrent first requests for same key share the same .tmp filename -> possible FileNotFoundError on replace (use unique tmp name).
Backend sets 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable' (verified on :8001) but preview ingress overrides it with no-store; not an app bug.

integration_issues.issue: Video still streams directly from nbg1.your-objectstorage.com (not proxied) so it remains exposed to the same intermittent 503 SlowDown; loaded fine during test.

issues: Title 'Nostalgie Vlaanderen/België' breaks mid-word ('Vlaanderen/B' / 'elgië') - overflow-wrap:anywhere/break-all; consider inserting <wbr> after '/' or using overflow-wrap:break-word

action_items: Implement the promised retry-on-5xx in fetch_news
Harden /api/img src validation against '..' path segments
Run PIL work in asyncio.to_thread, handle non-image content (return 502), use unique tmp filenames
Optional: fix mid-word break of 'Vlaanderen/België' card title; consider proxying/retrying video
critical_code_review_comments: imgUrl() in api.js proxies any image_url; if CMS ever returns an image outside the allowed prefix it will 400 - consider falling back to raw src when not matching prefix
Disk cache in tempdir has no eviction (fine for 4 articles)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=...; pytest /app/backend/tests. Cache-Control assertion accepts no-store due to preview ingress. Only article 3f4564a9 has an inline body image; 4e152384 (OVB) has the video.
